A cinematic ultra-wide GitHub banner featuring a bald human skeleton programming at a computer in a dark cyberpunk workshop. The composition strongly focuses on the skeleton, the glowing monitor, and the keyboard. The skeleton is seated at the desk, leaning forward with concentration and rapidly typing with both skeletal hands. He wears a weathered brown fedora, a tailored black suit, a crisp white dress shirt, and a straight black necktie. His skull, upper torso, arms, and typing hands are prominently framed and illuminated by the monitor. The environment is a dark and eerie atmosphere, almost super natural feeling

The large computer monitor is the visual centerpiece, displaying rapidly scrolling programming code, terminal windows, source files, waveform visualizations, digital audio software, artificial-intelligence interfaces, and complex system diagnostics. Streams of glowing programming code, binary symbols, brackets, command-line text, musical notes, sheet-music fragments, waveform patterns, and luminous data particles burst outward from the monitor and spiral dynamically around the skeleton. Bright orange flames leap dramatically from the top and sides of the monitor while electric sparks, glowing embers, and digital glitches scatter through the air. The flames appear energetic and supernatural without destroying the workstation or setting the entire room on fire.

The skeleton’s eye sockets reflect the monitor’s cold blue light. Strong highlights define the skull, cheekbones, teeth, finger bones, fedora brim, suit lapels, white shirt, and black necktie. His skeletal fingers are positioned naturally over a detailed mechanical keyboard, visibly pressing the illuminated keys. The scene conveys intense creative energy, as though programming, artificial intelligence, and music are erupting from the computer in real time.

A ceramic cup of hot coffee sits clearly visible beside the keyboard on the desk. Thick curls of steam rise from the coffee and catch the colored monitor light and orange firelight. The cluttered desk also contains computer components, circuit boards, loose cables, hard drives, USB devices, headphones, audio interfaces, handwritten programming notes, small tools, guitar picks, and illuminated control panels.

Behind the skeleton is a dense but readable workshop filled with uneven stacks of desktop computers, server towers, computer cases, graphics cards, motherboards, cooling fans, spare monitors, keyboards, tangled cables, electronic components, and salvaged machine parts. Large black studio speakers, smaller reference monitors, amplifiers, microphones, mixing equipment, rack-mounted audio processors, effects pedals, headphones, and other musical equipment fill the background.

Directly behind the seated skeleton, a clearly recognizable wooden mandolin rests upright and is propped against a large black studio speaker. The mandolin has a warm natural wood finish, a traditional carved body, visible strings, bridge, tuning pegs, and subtle signs of frequent use. Keep the mandolin clearly visible and unmistakable, but secondary to the skeleton and monitor.

The room resembles an underground cyberpunk programming studio combined with a musician’s workshop and a crowded computer-repair laboratory. Industrial metal walls, exposed pipes, ventilation ducts, improvised shelving, hanging cables, subtle LED indicators, dim fluorescent work lights, and faint holographic displays surround the workstation. Avoid excessive neon signage. Use atmospheric haze, illuminated smoke, floating dust, sparks, and volumetric light beams to create depth.

Dramatic cinematic lighting with cool cyan, deep blue, and muted purple monitor glow contrasted against vivid orange flames and warm reflections on the coffee cup and wooden mandolin. Ultra-wide horizontal GitHub banner composition, approximately 4:1 aspect ratio. Medium close-up three-quarter camera angle focused on the skeleton’s skull, upper body, hands, keyboard, and flaming monitor. Place the skeleton and monitor near the center-left while allowing atmospheric workshop details to extend across the wide frame. Keep all essential subjects inside the central safe area so the image can be cropped responsively. Sharp focus on the skeleton and monitor, slightly softer background, no full-body emphasis, no visible footwear, no text overlays, no logos, no watermark.
